tagline.de: Privater KI-Chat mit Open WebUI und Ollama nur auf der CPU
tagline.fr: Chat IA privé avec Open WebUI et Ollama sur CPU uniquement

tagline.ja: Open WebUI と CPU のみの Ollama によるプライベート AI チャット
tagline.ru: Приватный ИИ-чат с Open WebUI и Ollama только на CPU
tagline.hi: Open WebUI और केवल CPU पर चलने वाले Ollama के साथ निजी AI चैट

notes: Only Open WebUI publishes a loopback port. Ollama's unauthenticated API stays private at http://ollama:11434 and is never published.

WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL and WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD create the administrator only when no users exist. Successful headless admin creation disables sign-up; existing users and changed passwords are preserved on restart.

This is CPU-only: recipes do not expose GPUs. Small models of 4B parameters or less are realistic within Ollama's fixed 4g ceiling; model weights persist in a named volume and are downloaded separately.
The 2g application floor is provisional until both-OS live memory checks. Only the administrator login is shown; the generated WEBUI_SECRET_KEY persists with the application's secrets.
Exact release tags were verified for linux/amd64. Tested lists remain empty until live verification on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04.
